spec_match.rationale: Rule state is read from the rendered card (computed .card-inner flex-direction and .card-desc-full display), and the width comparison uses the content box the container query evaluates.

interactive.rationale: Two real toggle buttons set the custom properties, the container is drag-resizable with a ResizeObserver width readout, and the rule panel updates live (assessed from code review and the rendered DOM; the controls were not driven in this session).

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises a product card switching on width OR a custom-property flag with toggles — matching the page.

edge_cases.rationale: When rendered state disagrees with the conditions an explicit "comma-separated @container appears unsupported (requires Chrome 150+)" notice is shown; branch labels name width, style() or both.

references.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-04 (weekly hardening): the page now links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6196591858941952, matching its feature index — restoring invariant 3 and the fix-slugs self-heal. Verified by grep against the canonical id on the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The shared feature suite proves real parse/CSSOM contracts and honestly fails 4 of 5 here.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, unavailable in this cloud session) against a local server, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: force-wide on/off, show-full on/off, width slider 560/420 — readouts matched computed styles each time; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Baseline injected telemetry only; no interaction/assert events that would have exposed the readout-vs-render mismatch.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; card-btn.primary and toggle-btn.active set background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Force toggles expose aria-pressed; rules panel is a polite role=status; decorative card buttons are tabindex=-1 aria-disabled so they are not focus dead-ends; width slider is labelled.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow at 360px, and the style() branches work on mobile, but the stage caps at ~284px content there so the width branches (>360/>500) are not reachable on narrow phones.

summary: Weekly hardening 2026-11-15: rule readouts now observe the rendered card, added width slider, aria-pressed, live region, unsupported notice. Verified in headless Chromium 153 desktop+mobile with zero console errors.

guidanceConsulted.query: external reference links list rel noopener semantics
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep target=_blank external links on rel=noopener; no further guidance matched a plain reference-list addition.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the restored ChromeStatus links use target=_blank rel=noopener in the page's existing see-also list pattern; change is a reference-list fix only, no layout/control/CSS behavior touched.

guidanceConsulted.query: read computed style to reflect CSS state in JavaScript
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Container queries evaluate the container's content box; let CSS own the layout state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: readouts read getComputedStyle on the elements the rules style and measure the content box.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native buttons with programmatic state; announce dynamic state changes non-visually; do not add aria-pressed to a button whose label changes to describe its state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: aria-pressed on fixed-label toggles, polite role=status summaries.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Do not set container-type for style queries (every element is a style container); a style query only styles descendants of the element the property is set on, never that element itself.
